RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, so an all-male panel selecting between male finalists provides no basis for claiming sex discrimination. While an entirely male panel highlights a lack of institutional gender diversity, it did not place you at a disadvantage based on your sex. 

The hiring decision reflects a common preference in executive hospital roles for formal management qualifications and broad leadership experience over higher technical or academic credentials (a PhD). Raising gender composition will appear unfounded and unconstructive. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback, focusing on the specific leadership competencies the panel felt the successful candidate demonstrated.
